title: Binary digits from a real number
statement: For a real number $\rho$ and a natural number $i$, define the $i$th binary digit to be true exactly when the remainder modulo $2$ of the greatest natural number at most $2^{i+1}\rho$ is $1$; otherwise define it to be false.
